主要内容: Key Energy Services, Inc. (NYSE: KEG) has revised its schedule to report third quarter 2012 financial results. The company will release its financial results after market close on Wednesday, October 31, 2012. A conference call will be held on Thursday, November 1, 2012, at 10:00 a.m. CDT to discuss the results. U.S. and Canadian callers should dial 888-794-4637, while international callers should dial 660-422-4879. Callers should request the "Key Energy Services Conference Call" or provide access code 32988824. The webcast will be available at www.keyenergy.com under "Investor Relations." A replay will be accessible from Thursday, November 1, 2012, for one week and will remain available for at least 90 days on the company's website.
